Section(s): Appendix A. List of model equations (Kontoravdi et al., 2005)

Text and equations in reading order:
    The intraER MAb balance is
(25) \frac{d[H_{2}L_{2}]_{E R}}{d t}=K_{A}[H_{2}L][L]-K_{E R}[H_{2}L_{2}]_{E R}    [code: ODE, computes [H_2L_2]_{ER}, code proposes balance]
    Similarly, for the Golgi apparatus:
(26) \frac{d[H_{2}L_{2}]_{G}}{d t}=\varepsilon_{1}K_{E R}[H_{2}L_{2}]_{E R}-K_{G}[H_{2}L_{2}]_{G}    [code: ODE, computes [H_2L_2]_{G}, code proposes balance]
    Finally, the rate of MAb production is
(27) \frac{d([{M A}b])}{d t}=(\gamma_{2}-\gamma_{1}\mu)Q_{{M A}b}V X_{\nu}-F_{{o u t}}[{M A}b]    [code: ODE, computes [MAb], code proposes balance]
(28) Q_{M A b}=\varepsilon_{2}\lambda K_{G}[H_{2}L_{2}]_{G}    [code: algebraic, computes Q_{MAb}, code proposes constitutive]

Symbols:
  [H_2L_2]_{ER}: concentration of the ER‑localized H₂L₂ complex (computed)
  K_{A}: assembly rate constant for the formation of H from monomers [cell/molecule-L] (parameter)
  [H_2L]: concentration of the complex formed by H₂ and ligand L (parameter)
  [L]: concentration of light‑chain monomer [chain/cell·h] (computed)
  K_{ER}: rate constant for ER‑to‑Golgi transport [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  [H_2L_2]_{G}: concentration of the Golgi‑localized H₂L₂ complex (computed)
  \varepsilon_{1}: ER glycosylation efficiency factor [-] (parameter)
  K_{G}: rate constant for Golgi‑to‑medium antibody transport [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  [MAb]: concentration of monoclonal antibody in the reactor (computed)
  \gamma_{2}: constant for antibody production [h] (variable)
  \gamma_{1}: constant for antibody production [h] (variable)
  \mu: specific growth rate of viable cells [h^-1] (computed)
  Q_{MAb}: specific production rate of monoclonal antibody as defined by Eq. 28 (computed)
  V: reactor liquid volume [L] (computed)
  X_{\nu}: viable cell concentration (cells per volume) [cells L^-1] (computed)
  F_{out}: outlet volumetric flow rate [L h^-1] (variable)
  \varepsilon_{2}: Golgi apparatus glycosylation efficiency factor [-] (variable)
  \lambda: parameter appearing in Eq. 28 that scales the effect of K_G and substrate concentration on Q_{MAb} (variable)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  (none recorded)

laws.description: intra‑ER monoclonal antibody complex balance: accumulation equals assembly from H₂L and L minus transport to Golgi
Golgi‑localized antibody complex balance: accumulation equals glycosylated influx from ER minus transport to the medium

laws.eq: (27) \frac{d([{M A}b])}{d t}=(\gamma_{2}-\gamma_{1}\mu)Q_{{M A}b}V X_{\nu}-F_{{o u t}}[{M A}b]
laws.description: overall monoclonal antibody balance in the reactor: accumulation equals net specific production (growth‑adjusted) minus outlet removal
definition of the specific monoclonal antibody production rate as proportional to Golgi‑localized complex concentration
